newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB chief-EMU criteria must be closely followed.
newsitem.headline: WestLB chief-EMU criteria must be closely followed.

text.p: Management board chairman Friedel Neuber of the Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale said on Wednesday that he favoured strict adherence to the Maastricht criteria on European currency union (EMU).
Without this, all European Union countries would face enormous difficulties in qualifying for EMU in 1999, Neuber said at a seminar in Frankfurt.
Neuber said the room to manoeuvre within the Maastricht treaty would be used to ensure a punctual start to EMU, though how much leeway could be allowed was a political decision.

Neuber warned against excessive flexibility on the EMU criteria, and said that attempts by individual countries to delay certain aspects of the criteria went against the spirit and the letter of the Maastricht agreement.
An overly-generous interpretation of the criteria would affect the credibility of currency union, but sticking to the convergence criteria was more important than the 1999 deadline, Neuber said.
